sys_ux_event.description: Fires when a record is unpinned — from the header's own toggle or from a row's unpin button in the drawer. Payload: { table, sysId, label, item, count }.
sys_ux_event.label: Record unpinned
sys_ux_event.props: [ { "description": "Table of the unpinned record.", "fieldType": "string", "label": "Table", "name": "table", "valueType": "string" }, { "description": "sys_id of the unpinned record.", "fieldType": "string", "label": "Record Sys ID", "name": "sysId", "valueType": "string" }, { "description": "Title of the removed item, when known.", "fieldType": "string", "label": "Label", "name": "label", "valueType": "string" }, { "description": "Always null on unpin — the item no longer exists.", "fieldType": "json", "label": "Pinned item", "name": "item", "valueType": "string" }, { "description": "How many items remain pinned.", "fieldType": "number", "label": "Pinned count", "name": "count", "valueType": "string" } ]
